# SketchMotion official website migration

The official SketchMotion product website and seventeen localized pages have moved to https://sketchmotion-ed020.web.app/. The old GitHub landing pages are HTML migration pages with immediate meta refresh and a visible link, not server-side HTTP 301 responses.
